notes.title: Product version is now available!
notes.content:
[h3][b]The story of thieving girls who steal the "precious treasure that lies in the giant tower
The full version of "Thief Girl Quartet" will be available on Steam from February 4th![/b][/h3]

[b]What is the difference between the early access version and the full version? [/b]
1. The number of stages has been increased to 20.
　→ Gimmicks and high-rise areas have been added to increase the wire action playability.

2. The fastest time in a stage is now recorded and displayed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39161810/f974abfa83f8b91daeb399c3179a38a56c597dae.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=dRykE8dufDw;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: 【Online Mode】 Fixed a bug in the matching process.
notes.content:
To all the players who have been playing
Hello and good evening.

We have found a bug in the room matching of the online mode.
Thank you to those who reported it!

b]In room matching, there was a pattern where players could not join a room.
Also, a fatal error was found when joining a room. /b]

We've updated these bug fixes!

If you continue to have any bugs or comments, please feel free to write to us on
If you have any further bugs or comments, please feel free to post them on Twitter DM or in the community.

Thank you.

notes.title: English is now supported!
notes.content:
An app update has been released today with support for English notation.

Please update and play the game when playing on Steam.
There are no changes to other features.

If you want to play the game in English, please set the game properties > language settings to English.

Thank you.
